note: `responsiveTsx` now carries a verified property contract. The merged module is read at each collected width's slot (every array resolved as devup-ui resolves it, elements hidden there skipped) and compared with that width converted on its own: the same elements, the same settled values, every value one the width's own contract verifies, the same text, and nothing of the width left over. A component reference is checked by the component it names and the variant the width's instance picked. Only when every width agrees is `outputResults.responsiveTsx.fidelity.mergedMappingVerified` true; otherwise `mergeGaps` names the width, node and property where they part company, and the `unverified-responsive-merge` entry carries them. Before, the flag was always false, so every multi-width export reported `mapping-incomplete` whatever the module said. This compares code, not a rendering. A layer hidden at every width that has it is now left out of the module, as `tsx` leaves it out, instead of being written with `display: none`.
